entries.description: Venerable Ānanda approved what the Buddha said
entries.subject: Venerable Ānanda

spans.text: Satisfied, Venerable Ānanda approved what the Buddha said.
When he said this, Uttara sat silent, dismayed, shoulders drooping, downcast, depressed, with nothing to say.
The Buddha said to him, “deseti, uttara, pārāsiviyo brāhmaṇo sāvakānaṁ indriyabhāvanan”ti?
